summaryJa: 作戦名「INHERENT RESOLVE」下、89 ATKS所属の機（コールサイン1.4a）が2022-07-30 18:22ZにOJMSより離陸し、07-30 19:25Zに所定位置でTF CHOSINの指示に基づくIMINT任務を実施した。任務は合計20.9時間（ミッション時間20時間57分）、IMINT17.2時間、SIGINT18.7時間で、実行課題はIMINT1件・SIGINT1件、計2件。フルモーション映像はDGSIで解析済み。事前調整は103分、満足と評価。天候は要因でなかった。主要活動として多数の座標（37SFU…系列）を掃索・監視し、車列／車両（白・黒のPUT、白BONGO、ジープ、クアドキャブ、技術車両）、約30名の人員（ADM）、モーターサイクル、射撃場と推定される場所、搭載型対空火器や不明物（砲兵システムの可能性）等を観測・追跡した。07-30 23:52～07-31の間は複数地点を継続スキャンし、07-31 02:39Zに37SFU271…付近で未確認航空現象（UAP）を観測（UAP初接触DTG 310239ZJUL22）。UAP観測時の友軍機位置は37SFU4…付近、高度19,359 ft、対気速度116 kt。11:34ZにはTELAR（弾頭3発搭載）2台が非活動であるのを確認。TF CHOSINの指示で07-31 12:43Z（記録中の12432）にOFF TASKINGを受け、同日に基地へ帰還・着陸（着陸311519ZJUL22）。
summaryEn: Under Operation INHERENT RESOLVE, an 89 ATKS aircraft (callsign 1.4a) departed OJMS 301822ZJUL22 and on‑station 301925ZJUL22 to perform IMINT for TF CHOSIN. Mission totals: 20.9 hours (total mission time 20:57), 17.2 IMINT hours, 18.7 SIGINT hours; IMINT tasks prosecuted 1, SIGINT tasks prosecuted 1, total tasks prosecuted 2. Full‑motion video was exploited by DGSI. Precoordination with TF CHOSIN was 103 minutes and assessed satisfactory; weather was not a factor. The asset scanned multiple grid points (37SFU… series), observed and tracked a convoy and numerous personnel (ADM, ~30), vehicles including white/black PUTs, white Bongos, a jeep, quad‑cab, technical vehicles, motorcycle, stops and a location assessed as a possible shooting range, and suspected weapon systems (possible mounted AAA, possible artillery system). At 310239ZJUL22 an unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) was observed near 37SFU271… (initial contact DTG 310239ZJUL22); friendly aircraft location at UAP report was near 37SFU4…, altitude 19,359 ft, speed 116 kts. At 11342Z two TELAR with three rockets loaded were observed inactive. TF CHOSIN STA cleared the asset off tasking at 12432 and the aircraft returned and landed at OJMS (last land 311519ZJUL22).
